name: FA_LEASE_SCHEDULES_INT
description: This is a temporary table which is used internally by Oracle.

columns.name: LEASE_SCHEDULE_INTERFACE_ID
columns.description: Lease schedule interface identifier.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_NAME
columns.description: Transaction name for the asset. Free text field. No validations.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Classification of the lease transaction. Possible values are CREATE, UPDATE, and DELETE.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: WORKER_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier for parallel processing.

columns.name: ERROR_MSG
columns.description: Error message detailing failure of the posting program.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Fusion Enterprise Resource Planning: process ID of the process that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: POSTING_STATUS
columns.description: Status of the lease schedule.

columns.name: ASSET_SCHEDULE_NUM
columns.description: Unique Identifier of an asset lease schedule.

columns.name: LEASE_INTERFACE_ID
columns.description: Lease interface identifier.

columns.name: LEASE_NUMBER
columns.description: User-defined lease number of the lease.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Name of the asset book for which the transaction is defined.

columns.name: LINE_NUM
columns.description: Serial number for the payment types included in the lease payment schedule.

columns.name: LEASE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of lease. Leases can be classified as capital or operating leases.

columns.name: ASSET_NUMBER
columns.description: User-defined asset identification number for the leased asset.

columns.name: ASSET_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the leased asset.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Types of payments the lessee must make to the lessor as per the lease contract.

columns.name: LEASE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the lease payment starts as per lease contract.

columns.name: INTEREST_DUE_DATE
columns.description: Date when the interest on lease liability is to be calculated.

columns.name: PAYMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount payable as per the lease contract.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_INSTALLMENTS
columns.description: Number of lease payments the lessee has to pay as per the lease contract.

columns.name: INTEREST_RATE
columns.description: Incremental borrowing rate of the lessee to be used to calculate the present value of lease payments.

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.description: Number of units leased in a lease contract.

columns.name: UNIT_OF_MEASURE
columns.description: Identifies the unit of measure.

columns.name: EXCLUDE_IN_LIABILITY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a lease payment to be excluded in calculating the lease liability.

columns.name: INCLUDE_IN_COST_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a lease payment to be excluded in calculating the leased asset cost.

columns.name: PURCHASE_DATE
columns.description: Date when the lessee purchase the leased asset from lessor.

columns.name: TERMINATION_DATE
columns.description: Date when the lessee terminates the lease contract.

columns.name: NON_CANCELLABLE_LIFE_IN_MONTHS
columns.description: Number of months lease contract cannot be cancelled.

columns.name: EXTEND_PERIOD_IN_MONTHS
columns.description: Number of months the lease can be extended by the lessee.

columns.name: TERMINAL_PERIOD_IN_MONTHS
columns.description: Number of months the lessee has an option to terminate the lease.

columns.name: EXERCISE_PURCHASE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether lessee wants to purchase the leased asset.

columns.name: EXERCISE_EXTEND_RENEW_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the lessee wants to renew the lease.

columns.name: EXERCISE_TERMINATE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the lessee wants to terminate the lease.

columns.name: PV_TO_FV_SUBSTANTIAL_FLAG
